_meta.description: Saved cluster definitions for the Ratchet dataset. Each cluster is a named query: a thesis-relevant pattern that resolves to a set of persons via the standard query primitives. Updating the dataset auto-updates cluster membership.

clusters.label: Tap-Backdoor-Watchers Trinity
clusters.summary: Persons who touched both the Tap actor (SIGINT mass collection) and the Backdoor actor (encryption mandates). The book's headline overlap — surveillance authorities and the legal/operational architecture that built them.

clusters.label: Treasury Vault Loop
clusters.summary: Wall Street → US Treasury → Wall Street rotation across all administrations. The financial-services revolving door.

clusters.label: PayPal Mafia → Trump II Vault
clusters.summary: PayPal Mafia alumni installed in Trump II (Musk DOGE, Vance VP, Sacks AI/Crypto Czar) and their VC vehicles (Founders Fund, 8VC, Khosla). Convergence of tech-right operator class with executive power.

clusters.label: Trust & Safety / FBI Bridge
clusters.summary: FBI/DOJ NSD/CIA → Twitter/Meta/SIO content-moderation pipeline. The Flagging Machine click made operational via named individuals.

clusters.label: Tech-Right AI Policy Council
clusters.summary: Persons shaping AI governance architecture across administrations — founders, regulators, lobbyists. The Blueprint click cohort.

clusters.label: BigLaw Carousel
clusters.summary: DOJ → BigLaw partner → DOJ rotation. Backstop play executed through legal firms with persistent personnel pipelines.

clusters.label: China Influence Bridge
clusters.summary: Western cohort with documented institutional engagement at China-state nodes (Tsinghua, Boao Forum, China Development Forum, BRI, AIIB). Institutional-only on the Chinese side per anti-tinfoil rule.

clusters.label: Trilateral Carter Crew
clusters.summary: Trilateral Commission → Carter administration → think-tank pipeline. The named Cycle play at its peak.

clusters.label: CFR Pulpit
clusters.summary: CFR member → State Department → CFR/think-tank seat. The foreign-policy revolving door.

clusters.label: IMF Rumpelstiltskin
clusters.summary: IMF/World Bank pipeline → finance or regulator role → back to private capital. The named play for multilateral-to-private value extraction.

clusters.label: Bilderberg Cousin
clusters.summary: Sustained Bilderberg attendance while holding senior US position. The Cousin play — the supranational coordination pattern.

clusters.label: Federalist Judicial Pipeline
clusters.summary: Federalist Society network → White House Counsel → federal bench (DC Circuit, SCOTUS). The conservative legal infrastructure pattern.

clusters.label: OLC Surveillance-Memo Architects
clusters.summary: Office of Legal Counsel attorneys who authored the post-9/11 surveillance/interrogation legal framework. The Backdoor click's substrate authors.

clusters.label: Defense Contractor Backstop
clusters.summary: Defense officials → contractor C-suite/board → back to Defense. The 'rule about not lobbying the agency you just left' worked-around.

clusters.label: WEF Young Global Leaders in Office
clusters.summary: WEF Young Global Leader alumni who reached senior elected or appointed positions. Macron, Trudeau, Ardern, Sandberg, Hoffman cluster.

clusters.label: CFR Mass — the gravitational center
clusters.summary: All persons in the dataset with a documented Council on Foreign Relations affiliation. ~25% of named persons (currently ~85 of 342), making CFR the single most-central institution in the graph — connected to more than 4x as many persons as the next-largest institutional node (State Dept at ~38).

clusters.label: Supranational Coordination Class
clusters.summary: Persons holding membership in MULTIPLE supranational forums (CFR + Bilderberg + Trilateral). The 'Cousin' play's hardest expression — the named figures whose career arc passes through every supranational coordination layer simultaneously. Includes the Kissinger-gravity-field type figures (Kissinger, Rubin, Paulson, Rice, Schwarzman, Soros, Fink, Schmidt). Approximation of 'Kissinger Gravity Field' surfaced by the discovery script (Kissinger is the dataset's most-connected named person at 9 edges).

clusters.label: Facial Recognition Deployers
clusters.summary: Named persons leading facial-recognition / biometric-surveillance deployment at platform or product scale. Newly drained as the `model` actor tag was previously underused. Includes Clearview AI leadership (Ton-That, Schwartz), Palantir founders (Karp, Thiel, Lonsdale), Anduril (Luckey), Worldcoin/biometric-ID (Blania), platform-vision leadership (Schmidt, Pichai, Hassabis).

clusters.label: Digital ID / Papers Cohort
clusters.summary: Named persons running biometric-enrollment, digital-ID, or papers-equivalent deployment. Aadhaar architect Nilekani, Worldcoin (Blania), Mastercard/India Stack (Banga), Schmidt + Sandberg + Khan in platform-ID adjacent roles, Schwab + WEF on digital-ID advocacy.

clusters.label: British Ratchet
clusters.summary: The UK-state's parallel control-grid architecture: Chatham House (Royal Institute of International Affairs) + IISS + RUSI + King's War Studies as the brain trust; FCDO + Bank of England + MI5 + MI6 + GCHQ as the operational organs; documented UK persons (Blair, Cameron, BJohnson, Truss, Sunak, Starmer, Reeves, Carney, Sawers, Fleming, RMoore, Niblett, BMaddox, AParker, McCallum, Hadley-adjacent UK figures). Nation-state-keyed term — the British Ratchet is the UK's institutional analogue to the US Ratchet, with structural homologies (CFR↔Chatham House, RAND↔IISS, NSA↔GCHQ, FBI↔MI5, CIA↔MI6, Treasury↔Treasury+BoE) and operational pipeline differences (UK retains more peerage / honors / Crown-appointed structures; US retains more campaign-finance / lobbying coupling). Documented in the UK persons' multi-institution edge patterns.

clusters.label: European Ratchet
clusters.summary: EU-aligned parallel control-grid architecture: European Commission + ECB + ECFR + Bruegel + CER as the institutional brain trust; named figures Vestager (DSA architect), Breton (DSA enforcer), VonDerLeyen, Draghi, JBorrell, Macron, Kurz, Rutte. Nation-state-keyed (EU as a political union). Structural homology with US Ratchet but EU operates more through regulation (DSA, AI Act) and supranational coordination than through revolving-door personnel rotation.

clusters.label: Indian Ratchet
clusters.summary: Indian-state's parallel control-grid architecture: MEA + ORF + MP-IDSA + Gateway House + VIF as institutional brain trust; named persons Nilekani (Aadhaar architect), Jaishankar (current EAM), SMenon (ex-NSA), Doval (current NSA). Distinct shape from US/UK: India Stack (Aadhaar + UPI + DigiLocker + Account Aggregator) is the world's most-deployed digital-ID-and-payment-rails program. The Indian Ratchet exports its model — Philippines, Sri Lanka, Brazil have all imported variants.

clusters.label: Israeli Ratchet
clusters.summary: Israeli-state's parallel control-grid architecture: alumni-pipeline pattern (Unit 8200 → tech startups → commercial surveillance vendors) rather than think-tank-driven. Institutional anchors: Knesset, Mossad, Unit 8200, INSS (Tel Aviv), NSO Group (Pegasus), Cellebrite (mobile forensics), Black Cube (private intel). Named ex-officials: Netanyahu, Barak, Olmert, Livni, Bennett, YCohen (ex-Mossad chief), Barnea (current Mossad chief). Commercial-surveillance vendor abuses are documented in court records (NSO v. WhatsApp, Citizen Lab attribution reports) — those documents are the citation backbone, not allegations.

clusters.label: Canadian Ratchet
clusters.summary: Canada's parallel control-grid architecture: finance-first pattern (central bank → senior cabinet → think tank), Five Eyes membership. Institutional: CIGI, CSIS_Can (Canadian Security Intelligence Service), CSE_Can (signals), CGAI, Munk School, BoC. Named persons: Carney (BoC → BoE → UN Climate → Brookfield → PM 2025-), Trudeau, Freeland (FM/DPM/Finance), DJohnston (Governor General), Barton (McKinsey → Growth Council Chair → Ambassador to China → Rio Tinto Chair).

clusters.label: Australian Ratchet
clusters.summary: Australia's parallel control-grid architecture: defense-first pattern, explicit state-foundation fusion. Institutional anchors: ASIO + ASIS + ASD + ONI_AU (intelligence), ASPI + Lowy Institute (think tanks). Named: Albanese, Rudd (PM → Asia Society Policy Institute → US Ambassador), Turnbull (Goldman → PM), MPayne (FM/Defence → Hoover), TAbbott (PM → UK Board of Trade). ASPI's governance includes Defence Secretary + DFAT Secretary ex-officio — the cleanest example of state-foundation institutional fusion in any Ratchet.

clusters.label: Japanese Ratchet
clusters.summary: Japan's parallel control-grid architecture: bureaucratic meritocracy, LDP party-state fusion. JIIA (Japan Institute of International Affairs, chartered at Abe's initiative — state-aligned, not independent like Chatham House). Intelligence fragmented across PSIA + CIRO + JMOD + MOFA. De-facto Five Eyes sixth eye per CSIS. Named: Kishida (PM 2021-24), Abe (longest-serving PM, NSC architect, assassinated 2022), Motegi (FM continuity), Okazaki (Foreign Ministry diplomat → Okazaki Institute founder).

clusters.label: Korean Ratchet
clusters.summary: South Korea's parallel control-grid architecture: hybrid state-private model. Asan Institute (independent but policy-aligned) + KIDA (defense research). NIS_SK politically weaponized across multiple impeachments (Park 2017, Yoon 2025). Prosecutor-to-presidency pipeline (Yoon Suk-yeol: career prosecutor → Prosecutor General → President 2022-25). Transnational expert node Victor Cha (NSC Bush2 → CSIS Korea Chair → Georgetown → Asan). Named: Yoon, VCha, CKang (Asan President), Park.

clusters.label: Surveillance Customer Cohort
clusters.summary: Gulf states + Egypt as documented customers of Western/Israeli commercial-surveillance products (NSO Pegasus, Cellebrite, Cytrox Predator, Hacking Team). NOT operators of indigenous Ratchets — they buy and deploy what the Israeli/Western operator-states' alumni-pipeline produces. Customer states: Saudi Arabia (GIP_Saudi + KFCRIS + PIF), UAE (SSA_UAE + DarkMatter contractor-host + ADIA), Egypt (GIS_Egypt + Technical Research Division), Bahrain (NSA_Bahrain, LULU Pegasus operator). Qatar is non-player (defensive only). Per anti-defamation rule for foreign nationals: institutional-only.

clusters.label: The Green Priests — Climate / ESG / Net-Zero financialization
clusters.summary: Named architects of the climate-finance infrastructure. The 'fifth pawl' of the Priest archetype (Chapter 7 in The Ratchet), per author 2026-05-29: 'the climate people are also kind of like green priests.' Sits alongside Opus Dei, EA utilitarianism, progressive epistemic control, and WEF technocracy as variant priest-class operating control-grid mechanism. Persons: Fink (BlackRock), Carney (UN Climate Envoy + GFANZ + Canadian PM), Bloomberg (UN Climate Envoy + GFANZ + TCFD), Kerry (Biden Climate Envoy), Figueres (UNFCCC Paris architect), Espinosa (UNFCCC 2016-22), Stiell (UNFCCC 2022-), Yellen (FSOC climate authority), HMizuno (UN PRI + GPIF), BBadré (WB CFO → Blue like an Orange). Institutional: GFANZ + NZAOA + UN PRI + Climate Action 100+ + ISSB + NGFS + UNFCCC.

clusters.label: The Hospital — Health-Governance Ratchet
clusters.summary: The 'philanthropic-funding-determinism' structural pattern, distinct from the US/UK revolving-door Ratchets. Gates Foundation seeds Gavi (2000) and CEPI (2017) → Wellcome Trust co-funds CEPI → multilateral WHO (funding-dependent, 84% voluntary/earmarked, Gates is second-largest donor with 15-20% allocation influence per Politico) → PEPFAR (US bilateral). Personnel rotate but structural lock is funding conditionality, not employment. Named: Tedros (WHO DG), MChan (WHO DG predecessor), Fauci (NIAID), Farrar (Wellcome→WHO), Berkley (Gavi), Hatchett (BARDA→CEPI), Dybul (PEPFAR→Global Fund), Birx (WH Coronavirus Response), Slaoui (Operation Warp Speed), BGates, Suzman, RShah, Gawande, RFKJr. Institutional: Gavi + CEPI + Wellcome + WHO + WHO HEP + PEPFAR + NIAID + BARDA + GlobalFund + GISAID.

clusters.label: Diaspora PACs
clusters.summary: Horizontal cluster: country-of-origin diaspora political-action committees and advocacy orgs operating in US politics. Template-replication pattern: USINPAC's founders explicitly modeled it on AIPAC; subsequent formations across multiple country-of-origin communities followed similar templates (501(c)(3) education arm + 501(c)(4) lobbying arm + FEC PAC + congressional caucus liaison). Includes both embassy-aligned vehicles (USINPAC, OFBJP-USA, Impact-PAC, RHC, HAF, PAK-PAC, BAPAC, ANCA, AAA, ATFL, NaFFAA, CARECEN, KAGC) and reverse-aligned counter-home-state vehicles (US-Cuba Democracy PAC, CANF, FAPA, BPSOS). OFBJP-USA is the single documented FARA-registered foreign-agent presence (Aug 2020). Eritrea is an edge case that bypasses the PAC pattern entirely via embassy 2% Recovery Tax collection.
